plain.li: I didn't want to talk to anyone tonight. I talked to {X_definite} for an hour.
Bad week. Worse day. I don't think {X_definite} knows any of that, but {X_pronoun} lay on my feet anyway, which comes to the same thing.
[lowmood] Everything here is too heavy. Then {X_definite} came and sat on the heaviest part, which was me, and somehow that helped.
[night] Couldn't sleep. Went out to the pens and sat with {X_definite} until I could.
[grieving] I cried into {X_definite}'s side and {X_pronoun} just let me. Didn't flinch, didn't try to fix anything. That was the kindness.
[winter] Cold, dark, miserable. At least {X_definite} is warm, and doesn't mind how miserable I am.
[child] The grown-ups said I was being dramatic. I told {X_definite} instead, and {X_pronoun} didn't say anything rude at all.
[afterraid] My hands didn't stop shaking after the fighting until I had them on {X_definite}, warm and breathing.
[rain] Rain on the roof all night, and {X_definite} breathing next to me. I slept, which I haven't done in days.

warm.li: I keep thinking I should be the one looking after {X_definite}. Turns out it goes both ways.
[lowmood] Somebody should tell the others that the best medicine in this colony smells terrible and sleeps in the hay.
[old] At my age you stop expecting comfort from anybody. Then {X_definite} comes over and leans on you.

blunt.li: Don't need anybody. Got {X_definite}. That's plenty.
[lowmood] People keep asking how I'm doing. Only {X_definite} gets a straight answer.

cheerful.li: Felt rotten all day, and then {X_definite} did that silly little thing {X_pronoun} does with {X_possessive} head and I laughed so hard I snorted!
Note to self: when sad, go and find {X_definite}. Works every time! Has worked every time so far, anyway!

gloomy.li: The only one here who never needs me to be fine is {X_definite}.
[lowmood] One day I'll have to bury {X_definite}. Tonight I'm not thinking about that. Mostly.
[grieving] Everyone I've lost here, I lost fast. I've decided {X_definite} isn't allowed to go anywhere.

cold.li: My mood recovers faster in the animal's company. I've decided not to examine that too closely.
There was no angle in what {X_definite} did tonight. I'm not used to that. I found it confusing, then pleasant.

plain.li: Woke up to a present from {X_definite}. It was dead. Most of it.
I've been given a rat, laid out on my boot like a medal. I said thank you, and I meant about half of it.
[child] Today {X_definite} gave me a dead mouse. I'm keeping it in a box. Nobody is to throw it out.
[trait:Gourmand] Another gift from {X_definite}. I'll admit I looked at it and thought about seasoning. Not proud of that.
[night] Something crunched under my bare foot on the way to the latrine. A gift from {X_definite}. I don't want to talk about which part.
[winter] Food's scarce, and {X_definite} has started sharing. Generous. Disgusting, but generous.
[skill:Animals] I know what the gifts mean: you're family, you're a terrible hunter, here's some help. I'm choosing to be flattered.
[hot] It's far too hot for what {X_definite} left on my pillow. I've opened every shutter in the place.

warm.li: It's the thought that counts. The thought, from {X_definite}, was a dead bird. I made a fuss like it was gold.
[child] I gave {X_definite} a big hug for the present. I didn't touch the present.

blunt.li: Told {X_definite} to stop leaving corpses in my bed. The next one was in my boot. That's what I get for being specific.
Another dead thing on the step. At least someone around here is pulling their weight.
[afterraid] We're still cleaning up after the raid and {X_definite} brings me a dead bird. Everyone's a comedian.

cheerful.li: A present! From {X_definite}! It's a dead lizard! I've never been so honored or so queasy!
[morning] Best way to wake up: something dead, dropped on my chest, by someone very proud!

gloomy.li: Even the animals know the only gift out here is something dead.
[lowmood] At least somebody brings me things. Dead things, but still.

cold.li: The animal brings me its kills. It considers me part of its pack, and a poor provider. It isn't wrong.
Pest control, delivered to my door. I respect the efficiency.
[rich] The stores are full, and still the animal brings me rats. It isn't about need. I find that instructive.

plain.li: Something I liked is now in pieces, and {X_definite} is asleep on the pieces.
Hung my things up higher. Somehow {X_definite} found a way up. I'm almost impressed.
I've started keeping my belongings in a locked chest, like a miser. All because of one animal.
[winter] My good gloves, chewed through. In winter. By {X_definite}, who I'm sure planned it.
[child] Today {X_definite} ate my best stick. It was the best one. I will never find another stick like it.
[trait:Greedy] I'm keeping a list of everything {X_definite} has destroyed. Someday, somebody is paying me back for all of it.
[rain] Stuck indoors with {X_definite} all day. Lost a sandal, a belt and most of my patience.
[newcomer] I've been here less than two weeks and {X_definite} has already eaten one of my boots. Welcome to the colony, I suppose.

warm.li: I can't stay angry at something that looks that pleased with itself. I tried. I lasted about as long as the boots did.
It's only leather. I said that out loud three times today, so it must be true.

blunt.li: One more chewed boot and that animal sleeps outside. I mean it this time. Again.
Whoever taught {X_definite} that leather is food can come and pay for it.
[morning] Woke up, reached for my belt. Half a belt. Great start.

cheerful.li: My boots have holes in them now! Air flow! Very fashionable! Thank you so much, {X_definite}!
[highmood] Found my spoon chewed into a little sculpture! I'm keeping it! It's art now!

gloomy.li: Nothing I own survives here. Not my boots, not my plans. The animal is just quicker about it.
[lowmood] Of course it was my things. It's always my things.
[poor] We can't spare a single strap, and {X_definite} ate two.

cold.li: The animal destroys only my belongings. Either it has taste, or it has worked out which of us won't retaliate. I may correct that impression.
Losses so far: boots, a spoon, a strap. I've started charging them to the animal's account, payable in meat.

plain.li: Me and {X_definite} played chase all afternoon. I won four times. The other times don't count.
I told {X_definite} my biggest secret. Now we both know it and nobody else does.
[summer] Me and {X_definite} found a puddle. We are not allowed in the house now.
[winter] I built a snow animal so {X_definite} would have a friend. It got knocked over in about a minute. I think that means they're friends.
[rain] It rained so we played inside. Something got broken. I'm not saying what, or who.
[trait:Kind] I gave {X_definite} half my lunch because sharing is good. Then I gave the other half, because of the eyes.
[evening] When I grow up I'm going to have a hundred animals, and {X_definite} will be the boss of all of them.
[morning] I got up extra early so me and {X_definite} could play before chores. The chores did not get done.

warm.li: I asked the grown-ups if {X_definite} can sleep in my bed. They said no. We'll see about that.
Today I brushed all the burrs off {X_definite} and {X_pronoun} let me, nearly the whole time.
[hurt] I scraped my knee, and {X_definite} sat with me the whole time I was being brave about it.

blunt.li: The grown-ups are boring. Not {X_definite}. Easy choice.
Somebody said {X_definite} is just livestock. I kicked them. I'd do it again.

cheerful.li: BEST DAY! Me and {X_definite} found a frog and a beetle and a rock that looks like a face!
I taught {X_definite} to dance! Well, I danced, and {X_pronoun} watched, but it counts!
[snow] SNOW! Me and {X_definite} rolled around in it until I couldn't feel my ears!

gloomy.li: [lowmood] Everyone else is always busy. Only {X_definite} has time for me.
I asked if animals live forever. Nobody answered properly. I'm going to play with {X_definite} extra hard, just in case.

cold.li: I've worked out exactly how much {X_definite} will put up with. It's a lot more than the grown-ups will.
Playing with the animal is useful. The adults smile when they see me do it, and then they leave me alone.

plain.li: Took the long way round today so {X_definite} could keep up. Told everyone it was for the view.
There's gray creeping in around {X_definite}'s face. When did that happen? Where was I?
I remember when {X_definite} could clear a fence. Today the step was a whole decision.
[winter] The cold is hard on {X_definite} this year. I've given up my spot by the fire. Don't tell anyone.
[night] Sometimes I wake up just to listen for {X_definite} breathing. It's still there. Every time, so far.
[old] We're both getting slow, {X_definite} and me. At least we're slow together.
[summer] I let {X_definite} sleep in the sun all afternoon. We've both earned that much.
[rain] Wet days make {X_definite} stiff. I rub {X_possessive} legs by the fire, and we both pretend it's a treat and not medicine.

warm.li: Softer food for {X_definite} from now on. I'll mash it myself if I have to. I have to.
[grieving] I can't lose anyone else. I've told {X_definite} so. Several times.

blunt.li: Anybody makes a joke about {X_definite} being past it, they'll be past it too.
Old, slow and stubborn, {X_definite} and I. Good company.

cheerful.li: My old friend is officially a dignified elder! I bow to {X_definite} every morning! I get a yawn in return!
We went for a walk today! A short one! With lots of sitting down! It was perfect!

gloomy.li: Every animal I've ever loved has died before me. I knew that when I took on {X_definite}. I did it anyway.
[lowmood] Some mornings I check that {X_definite} is still breathing before I check anything else.
[fall] The leaves are coming down and {X_definite} sleeps a little more every day. I don't like how those two things feel together.

cold.li: The usefulness of {X_definite} is declining. I'm keeping {X_objective} anyway. I don't fully understand that decision.
I calculated roughly how much time is left. Then I stopped doing that calculation.
[highmood] A good day: {X_definite} ate well and walked farther than last week. I've written down the distance. I'll compare.

plain.li: Saw {X_indefinite} today. Really saw one, close. I keep holding my arms out to show people the size, and my arms aren't long enough.
Plenty of things on this world have wanted to kill me. Today I saw {X_indefinite} that didn't care either way, and it was the most beautiful thing yet.
[skill:Animals] I've spent my whole life with animals. None of them prepared me for {X_definite}.
[morning] Before breakfast: {X_indefinite} at the edge of the trees, steam rising off {X_possessive} back. I forgot I was hungry.
[winter] Watched {X_indefinite} wade through the drifts like they weren't there. Nothing on this world is built for winter except that.
[child] I saw {X_indefinite}! Bigger than a house! Maybe two houses! I am never going to forget it.
[trait:Bloodlust] Saw {X_indefinite} today. My first thought was what a fight that would be. My second was that I'd lose.
[trait:Greedy] I keep thinking about what that hide would fetch from a trader. Then I remember the size of {X_possessive} feet.
[evening] At sunset {X_indefinite} crossed the ridge, dark against the red sky. Nobody said a word until the light was gone.

warm.li: I hope nobody ever hunts {X_definite}. I hope {X_pronoun} lives a very long time, somewhere far from us and our spears.
[spring] Saw {X_indefinite} standing knee-deep in the new grass, and for once I didn't think about anything at all.
[trait:Kind] I left a bucket of water and the best of the scraps out by the far field for {X_definite}. Nobody needs to know where they went.

blunt.li: Saw {X_indefinite}. Huge. Didn't eat anybody. Good day.
Everyone stood around gawking at {X_definite} like they'd never seen an animal. Fine. I gawked too.

cheerful.li: I saw {X_indefinite} today and I've decided we're friends now! Nobody has told {X_definite} yet! I'll break it gently!
Huge! Enormous! Majestic! I ran out of words and just pointed for a while!

gloomy.li: Something that big and that free, and here I am inside a fence, counting potatoes.
We'll probably end up eating {X_definite}, or the other way round. Still. For an hour today it was just beautiful.
[poor] We're half-starved, and {X_definite} is walking around with a season's worth of meat on {X_objective}. Somebody's going to say it. Not me.

cold.li: Observed {X_indefinite} at length: weight, temperament, the leg {X_pronoun} favors. With the right preparation, I could take {X_objective}.
I felt something while watching {X_definite} today. I've identified it as awe. Unusual. I'll note the conditions.

plain.li: Up before anyone. Mist on the fields, and {X_indefinite} grazing in it like a ghost with an appetite.
I didn't do anything with the moment. I just stood there and watched {X_indefinite} until it was over.
[fog] Fog so thick I heard {X_indefinite} before I saw {X_objective}. Then I saw {X_objective}, and stood there until my hands went numb on the bucket.
[spring] New grass, and {X_indefinite} nibbling at it by the fence. Everything out here is trying to live. Nice to see it working for someone.
[fall] Leaves coming down, {X_indefinite} picking through them. Neither of us in any hurry. That's rare here.
[afterraid] Two days ago there was blood on that field. This morning {X_indefinite} was eating clover there like nothing happened. I needed to see that.
[trait:NightOwl] I was going to bed as the sun came up, and there was {X_indefinite} down by the water. Worth staying up for.
[rain] Soft rain at dawn, and {X_indefinite} standing in it, not caring at all. I stood in it too, for a bit.

warm.li: I wanted to wake someone to see {X_definite}, but I didn't dare move in case I scared {X_objective} off. So now it's just mine. Sorry, everyone.
[child] I saw {X_indefinite} this morning and I was so quiet. The quietest I've ever been in my life.

blunt.li: Nice morning. Animal by the fence. Didn't eat it. Growth.
Somebody slammed a door and scared off {X_definite}. I know who. They know I know.

cheerful.li: I said good morning to {X_indefinite} at the fence! The reply was running away! Still counts as a conversation!
[spring] Mist! Flowers! A wild animal! It's like a painting, if paintings smelled of manure!
[morning] A wild animal in the mist, first thing! Today is going to be a good one! I've decided!

gloomy.li: Watched {X_indefinite} graze at first light. Peaceful. Things are always peaceful right before they aren't.
[lowmood] Even {X_definite} looked happier than me this morning, and {X_pronoun} eats grass.
[winter] Watched {X_indefinite} paw at the frozen ground for anything at all. I know the feeling.

cold.li: Watched {X_indefinite} at dawn for some time. There was no purpose to it. I allowed it anyway.
The animal by the fence was calm, healthy and well fed. I noted where it beds down. Habit.

plain.li: Something out there has learned our routines. I saw {X_indefinite} at the fence again, right when I go for water. I'm changing when I go for water.
I worked the whole day with my back to the wall. Never once turned it to the trees.
[night] I can see the tree line from my bed. I wish I couldn't.
[trait:Wimp] Didn't go outside today. Nobody's asked why. Good, because the reason is {X_indefinite}.
[trait:Bloodlust] All afternoon {X_definite} watched me. Tomorrow I'm going out to watch {X_objective} back, with a spear in my hand.
[winter] Winter makes everything hungry, and from the way {X_definite} looks at us, we're on the menu.
[child] There was {X_indefinite} by the fence looking at me. I wasn't scared. I just ran inside really fast for other reasons.
[fog] Fog all day. Couldn't see {X_definite}. Knew exactly where {X_pronoun} was anyway. The back of my neck knew.

warm.li: I brought the children in early today and told them it was for supper. It was because of {X_definite}.
I hope {X_definite} finds something else to eat. Something that isn't us. I hope that for both our sakes.

blunt.li: That animal keeps staring at me like I'm dinner. I'm stringy. Somebody tell it.
If {X_definite} wants a fight, {X_pronoun} can wait in line like everyone else.
[trait:Tough] Let it watch. I've been looked at by worse, and they're dead.

cheerful.li: Guess who followed me around all day: {X_indefinite}! Hasn't eaten me yet! I think we're bonding!
Being stalked is wonderful exercise! I've never fetched water so fast in my life!

gloomy.li: Something out there is patient. More patient than us. That's how these stories usually end.
[lowmood] Even the wildlife thinks I look like an easy meal.

cold.li: The predator out there is doing exactly what I'd do: watching, waiting, choosing the weakest. I've started walking with the others.
Watched it watch me. Respect, of a sort. Nothing personal on either side.
[night] It came close to the fence after dark. I stood at the window and let it see me. It should learn something too.

plain.li: Crusts on the flat stone again, and again they were gone by noon. I didn't see who took them, but I can guess: {X_indefinite}.
Today {X_indefinite} ate from my hand. My hand still feels like it belongs to somebody else.
[spring] There's {X_indefinite} that comes to the edge of the field every day now. I've started saving bits of my lunch.
[winter] Pickings are thin out there. I'm sharing mine with {X_indefinite}. Don't tell the cook.
[child] I have a secret friend. It's {X_indefinite}. I give my crusts to my secret friend and nobody knows.
[skill:Animals] Moved slowly, never looked straight at {X_objective}, kept my breathing even. Took a week. Worth it: {X_definite} let me close enough to touch.
[trait:Ascetic] I gave my lunch away to {X_indefinite}. I didn't need it. Neither of us said thank you.
[rain] Even in the rain, {X_definite} came for the crusts. We stood there getting wet together. Felt like an appointment.

warm.li: I know I shouldn't feed wild things. I also know what it's like to be hungry out here.
I hope {X_definite} is warm tonight, wherever {X_pronoun} sleeps.
[evening] At dusk I sat very still, and {X_definite} came and sat near me. Not with me. Near. It's a start.

blunt.li: Yes, I feed {X_indefinite}. No, I won't stop. Next question.
Fed the little beggar again. Don't know why. Mind your own business.

cheerful.li: I've named my little wild friend! I won't say what! It's after someone on the council!
Today it came within an arm's length! Tomorrow, a finger closer! I have a whole plan!

gloomy.li: Everything out there gets eaten eventually. It might as well be my crusts first.
[lowmood] The only living thing glad to see me today was {X_indefinite}, and only because of the bread.
[afterraid] After everything this week, feeding {X_indefinite} felt like the only thing I did right.

cold.li: I'm conditioning {X_definite} with food. It's working. People work the same way, given patience.
The small animal trusts me now. Trust is cheap to build and expensive to break. A useful lesson, repeated.

plain.li: I touched {X_definite}. Actually touched {X_objective}. My hand is still shaking and I can't stop grinning.
Everyone keeps telling me what an idiot I was. They're right. I'd do it again tomorrow.
Note for whoever reads this after I'm gone: it was worth it.
[hurt] Writing this one-handed, for reasons I'd rather not go into. For the record, {X_definite} is perfectly fine.
[trait:Bloodlust] Poked {X_definite} to see what {X_pronoun} would do. Honestly a little disappointed.
[trait:TooSmart] I had a theory about how close you can get to {X_indefinite} before {X_pronoun} reacts. I have data now.
[child] I poked {X_indefinite} with a stick and all the grown-ups went white. I'm not allowed outside for a week.
[afterraid] We'd just survived a raid, and I thought: why not poke the big animal? In my defense, I was still a bit out of my mind.

warm.li: I only wanted {X_definite} to know we mean no harm. I'm not sure that's how {X_pronoun} took it.
I'm sorry, {X_definite}. And I'm sorry, everyone else. But mostly {X_definite}.

blunt.li: Yes, I poked it. Stop asking. It was there and I had a stick.
Everybody's very brave until it's time to actually go and poke the thing.
[highmood] Felt great today. Felt invincible. Was wrong about one of those.

cheerful.li: I TOUCHED IT! It was warm and it smelled awful and I'm alive! Best day!
New rule for myself: only poke the small ones! Learned that today! Great day for learning!
[summer] Hot day, big animal, long stick! The perfect recipe for a story!

gloomy.li: Did a stupid thing today and didn't die. That's the whole entry.
We're all getting eaten by something eventually. I just wanted to know what it felt like first.

cold.li: Approached {X_definite} to test {X_possessive} temper. Results inconclusive. Further testing advised, ideally by someone else.
The others called it reckless. It was a measured risk. I measured it afterwards.

plain.li: Saw {X_definite} at the tree line today. I knew {X_objective} by the walk, before anything else.
My scars itched all morning. Then I looked up, and there was {X_definite}.
[night] I keep the shutters closed now, because somewhere past them is {X_definite}, and I can feel which way.
[hurt] Still not healed, and {X_definite} came by to look at me. Checking on {X_possessive} work.
[trait:Bloodlust] The beast came back. Good. I've been sharpening for this since the day I could stand.
[trait:Wimp] Saw {X_definite} and hid in the storeroom until dark. I don't care who knows.
[winter] The snow shows everything: {X_definite} walked the whole length of our fence last night, slowly, as if counting us.
[afterraid] As if the raid wasn't enough, {X_definite} was at the tree line this morning, watching us clean up.

warm.li: I don't want anyone else hurt by {X_definite}. I told them all to stay in. Then I went out and stood at the fence anyway.
I wish I could forgive an animal for being an animal. I can't. Not this one.
[trait:Kind] Part of me pities {X_definite}, out there alone and hungry. The rest of me remembers the teeth.

blunt.li: Saw {X_definite} again. Next time, one of us doesn't walk away.
Everyone keeps saying it's just an animal. Then everyone can go out there and pat it.
[hurt] Still bandaged, and that beast comes back to gloat. Cheap.

cheerful.li: My old friend the people-eater is back! I'm laughing about it! I'm laughing so I don't throw up!
Some people get letters. I get a visit from {X_definite} at the tree line every few weeks! So thoughtful!

gloomy.li: It's going to get me in the end. I've always known that. Today {X_definite} came by to remind me.
[lowmood] The waiting is the worst part. Some nights I'd almost rather {X_definite} just came in.

cold.li: Watched {X_definite} at the tree line and made notes: approach, wind, the hours {X_pronoun} keeps. Next time, I choose the ground.
It hurt me once. That gave it an advantage it no longer has.
